---
title: "Lorenz-84 System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& -y^20z^2-x+1\\
\dot{y} &=& y-xz+ay+1\\
\dot{z} &=& xy+xz-z
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.1$ and initial condition $(-5,-1,-2)$.
